WEBSITE INFORMATION

Your privacy.

Last updated: 23 September 2026.

About this website

This website presents Grandison Plumbing & Heating, operated by Connor Grandison in Fife, Scotland.

Enquiry information

This website does not collect enquiry forms. Call or text the business using the displayed number, or use the linked Facebook page. Your chosen phone, messaging or social service handles that communication under its own terms and privacy information.

External services

Links to Facebook, Instagram and other websites take you to services with their own privacy notices. Those services control the information you share with them.

Hosting and fonts

The hosting provider may process technical request information to deliver and protect the website. Fonts are requested from Google Fonts, which receives technical connection information, such as your IP address, when your browser requests them.

Analytics and advertising

This version does not include analytics or advertising trackers. It does not create marketing profiles or mailing-list subscriptions.

Contact

For privacy questions, use the contact options on our contact page relating to the business. The contact details on this site are supplied by the business.
